title: PRISM/A — Q: Quality
description: Quality snapshots, SLOs, and tech debt records for components in the application landscape.

quality_metrics.description: Point-in-time quality snapshots for components. Capture what's true now, not what's aspirational.

name.description: Human-readable label for this quality record.

component_id.description: The component ID (from the C dimension) this quality record describes.

description.description: Context and observations about this component's quality.

last_assessed.description: Date this quality data was last verified or updated.

tech_debt_level.description: Overall tech debt severity for this component.

tech_debt_notes.description: Description of specific tech debt items and their root cause.

tech_debt_resolution.description: Planned approach or linked migration program to resolve the tech debt.

reliability.description: Observed reliability of this component in production.

security_posture.description: Current security posture based on last assessment or audit.

slo_target.description: The SLO target value (e.g. '99.9% availability', 'p95 < 200ms'). Required when artifact_type is 'slo'.

slo_current.description: Current measured value against the SLO target.

breach_history.description: Historical SLO breaches. Each entry is a date or period description.

depends_on.description: Component IDs that this quality record also references (e.g. upstream dependencies affecting reliability).
